access_notes: Wiley full article was accessible via the search connector. Direct bytes were not archived; the CSV leaves the full-text SHA-256 field blank for that article.

Several motor studies offer raw captured waveforms on reasonable request. None of those are reported here as public data releases. A publisher XML download for 10.3390/en17236096 returned HTML; both the PDF and ZIP were subsequently fetched from the publisher.
Crossref reference indexes may differ from printed bibliography numbering, especially for bilingual IEEJ texts. Citation locators use the printed numbers.

J-STAGE landing pages and some English titles have typographical variants. 10.1541/ieejias.122.120 appears as Indiredt/Indirect; 10.1541/ieejias.128.208 as Proportinal/Proportional. The canonical DOI unifies these forms.
excluded_leads: 10.13973/j.cnki.robot.180203 emerged from search; no independently examined full-text result in this subset.
